tasks.Friendship: Building a friendship with the interviewer is generally not recommended for a formal job interview setting.
tasks.MakeEyeContact: Making eye contact with the interviewer during a job interview is important as it shows confidence and engagement.
tasks.SmallTalk: Engaging in small talk can help establish rapport but should be kept brief and relevant to the context of the interview.
tasks.SocialLife: Discussing personal social life during a job interview is inappropriate.
